label: НОИ отвори врати и отчита над 120 приети граждани в София (21 ноември)
text: The first open-door day of the „Попитай НОИ“ campaign took 9:00–12:00 at the Sofia headquarters and the institute reports more than 120 people received, with the managing director and a deputy taking questions personally; the dominant caseload was proving insurance service from enterprises that were wound up without a successor, plus early retirement, inheritance pensions and ПИК/e-services. Regional outlets (Blitz) described the queues as hundreds rather than hundreds-plus. The institute says territorial branches join from the start of 2027, so the Sofia event is the only one held so far.
